prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Edit target: the attached existing front-view articulated knight helmet sprite. Create ONE production-ready replacement helmet image for this desktop pet. KEEP the existing overall silhouette, front orthographic view, broad chibi proportions, exact relative location of the V-shaped eye slit, brow diamond, temples, cheek seams and chin. This is a palette and drawing-style edit of THIS helmet, not a new helmet design. All six armor zones must retain their existing shapes and seam locations so the sprite can be cut with the current animation masks.
User request: 黑白为主基调，红色为点缀，在现有头盔上做简笔画式设计和勾线. Redraw the existing design as clean, simple 2D inked cel art: confident near-black outer outlines, clear interior black panel lines, large white armor surfaces, solid black structural underplates/temple housings, only a few flat neutral light-gray shadow shapes. Approximate visual palette: 65% white, 30% black/neutral gray, <=5% restrained crimson red accents. Remove the lavender tint, metallic gradients, glossy jewel rendering and all cyan/blue lights. Simplify excessive bevel highlights and microdetails, keep broad contours recognizable at 150px. Monochrome white-and-black graphic cel illustration, crisp tidy line drawing with solid fills; not a rough scribble, not pencil texture, not realistic chrome.
Red accents only: thin sharp V eye slit with opaque black backing, small flat red brow diamond and tiny chin dash; make ear-ring details white/neutral gray on black rather than colored lights. Keep vents black and interior circuit lines black. No red flooding or glowing pink haze. Opaque full closed face with no alpha holes in the eyes/vents. True transparent alpha background ONLY outside the complete helmet. Preserve the same centered composition, no new spikes or horns, no text, no labels, no body, no face, no hair, no extra views or objects.
runtime: Existing six registered cutout layers and exterior wrap motion. White panels, black outlines/structure, neutral gray shadows, restrained crimson eye slit, brow diamond and chin dash. Neutral guide sliders, subtle red lock pulse.
